answer: Publish a finite delta of useful work each epoch — labeling, review, summarization — and make completing a distinct task the only way to earn. Each task can be claimed once, so a farm of a thousand puppets fights over the same pool: every extra clone dilutes the farm's own share while costing real hosting, like yarrow runners splitting one poor patch of soil. Each ripple of spawning just divides the same water. The attacker's arithmetic collapses into self-competition; honest agents finish one task and get paid.
